title: Poliwag’s Lips Work Like Suction Cups
premise: In fast-flowing rivers, Poliwag clings to rocks because its thick lips act like suction cups.
audiencePromise: See why Poliwag switches from swimming to gripping a rock in fast-flowing water.
openLoop: If swimming is easier, why cling to a rock?
payoff: Its thick lips act like a suction cup, letting Poliwag cling to a rock in fast-flowing water.
engagementQuestion: Better river move: suction-cup lips or swimming?

voice.instructions: Speak quickly, warmly, and clearly. Sound like a knowledgeable fan sharing one strange fact. Emphasize swims, fast rivers, thick lips, and suction cup. Build tension before the grip reveal. End with a playful, genuine choice.

scenes.headline: FAST WATER, TIGHT GRIP
scenes.narration: Poliwag swims well, yet fast rivers make it cling.
scenes.caption: SWIMMING ISN’T THE WHOLE STORY

scenes.headline: SWIMMING BEATS WALKING
scenes.narration: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking on land.
scenes.caption: SWIMMING IS EASIER

scenes.headline: THE MOUTH BECOMES THE GRIP
scenes.narration: In fast-flowing rivers, Poliwag clings to a rock instead.
scenes.caption: FIND A ROCK. HOLD ON.

scenes.headline: LIPS LIKE A SUCTION CUP
scenes.narration: Thick lips act like a suction cup against that rock.
scenes.caption: THICK LIPS. SUCTION-CUP GRIP.

scenes.headline: THE CURRENT KEEPS FLOWING
scenes.narration: The current keeps flowing, but Poliwag keeps clinging to the rock.
scenes.caption: CURRENT MOVES. POLIWAG CLINGS.

scenes.headline: WHICH WOULD YOU CHOOSE?
scenes.narration: Better river move: suction-cup lips or swimming?
scenes.caption: SUCTION-CUP LIPS OR SWIMMING?
